title: Conditional revalidation for QUERY requests
prompt: `req.fresh` only checks freshness for GET and HEAD requests, so a QUERY request with a matching `If-None-Match` never gets a 304. QUERY is a safe, cacheable method: make `req.fresh` support it in the same way.

fail_to_pass: req .fresh should return true for a QUERY request with a body when the resource is not modified
pass_to_pass: req .fresh should ignore "If-Modified-Since" when "If-None-Match" is present
req .fresh should return false for a QUERY request with a body when the resource is modified
req .fresh should return false when the resource is modified
req .fresh should return false without response headers
req .fresh should return true when the resource is not modified
